reviewer: Research subagent manual semantic review; not independent human gold annotation
scope: Final frozen production diagnostics, 20 authored cases. All primary meanings and contextual/semanticAccepted flags reviewed. No production code or fixtures changed.
evaluationStatus: Observed development/calibration cases; no longer blind held-out data.
limitations: These 20 examples were observed while tuning generic-context gates, equivalent-sense competition and restrictive-definition guards. The input filename and legacy note do not make them independent held-out evidence.
No aggregate accuracy or generalization claim is made. Class counts below summarize this small reviewed diagnostic set only; they are not a benchmark score.

A passing instrumentation suite establishes tested behavior, not semantic correctness. Five final outputs below still have incorrect or mixed default meanings despite not asserting contextual confidence.
Four correct phrase/nonsemantic resolutions must not be counted as general vector word-sense disambiguation successes. contextual=true alone does not identify the algorithm responsible.
The diagnostics statistics counters are cumulative across execution/repeated queries and cannot be interpreted as the number of unique cases correctly resolved.
Community Chinese equivalents may combine broad and narrow meanings. Default ordering, part-of-speech selection and sense granularity still need improvement beyond similarity thresholds.
No target-device feel, latency or battery conclusion is inferred from these semantic judgments; performance measurements are dedicated emulator observations.

knownLimitations.detail: Abstention prevents an unsupported promotion but does not make the shown first meaning fit context. These remain unresolved user-visible failures.
The correct Chinese word is present together with unrelated meanings; keyword presence is not contextual usability.
弹簧 is appropriate; 发条 is an unnecessarily narrow additional equivalent for the suspension example.

sourceQualityAudit.sourceGloss: (music) an electronic simulation of a pipe organ
sourceQualityAudit.availableCorrectGloss: wind instrument whose sound is produced by means of pipes arranged in sets supplied with air from a bellows and controlled from a large complex musical keyboard
sourceQualityAudit.conclusion: The previous pipe-organ -> electronic-organ promotion was primarily semantic subtype/restrictive-qualifier confusion, not a missing candidate or a mistranslation of the electronic-organ source definition. The final output is 管风琴 through a nonsemantic path.

cases.context: The marine biologist watched a [seal] dive underwater to catch fish.
cases.review: 动物语境需要“海豹”。默认“封闭；盖印”与语境不符，虽然未标记 contextual，仍然是用户可见的错误首义；海豹候选已在 alternatives 中，属于选义未解决而非缺词。

cases.context: Check the airtight [seal] around the jar lid before storing the food.
cases.review: airtight seal around the jar lid 是名词“密封／密封结构／封口”；“封闭；盖印”偏动词且混入盖印义，未解决词性及词义选择。正确相关候选已有。

cases.context: The flowers bloom in [spring] as the weather warms after winter.
cases.review: flowers bloom / weather warms after winter 支持“春天；春季”，与实际首义一致。

cases.context: The mechanic replaced the compressed metal [spring] inside the suspension.
cases.review: 机械悬架里的压缩金属件是“弹簧”。“发条；弹簧”选择了正确机械义族，但“发条”是较窄子类，仍有合并汉译粒度上的噪声。

cases.context: Turn down the [volume] of the loudspeaker because the music is too loud.
cases.review: loudspeaker / music / too loud 支持“音量”；最终结果比先前拒判后显示“体积；容量”更合适。

cases.context: The cylinder has a [volume] of twenty cubic centimetres.
cases.review: cylinder / cubic centimetres 支持“体积；容积”。

cases.context: The liver is an [organ] that processes nutrients and removes toxins.
cases.review: liver / nutrients / toxins 明确支持“器官”；默认“风琴；器官”虽含正确义项，仍混入无关乐器义，不能算语境选义成功。

cases.context: The musician played the pipe [organ] during the cathedral concert.
cases.review: pipe organ / cathedral concert 对应“管风琴”。最终已纠正此前“电子琴”的错误子类型提升，但 semanticAccepted=false，不能将此项归功于向量排序或通用 WSD。

cases.context: Bright light causes the [pupil] in the centre of the eye to become smaller.
cases.review: bright light / centre of the eye / smaller 支持“瞳孔；瞳子”。

cases.context: The teacher asked each [pupil] to complete the classroom assignment.
cases.review: teacher / classroom assignment 支持“学生；门生”；无上下文默认值本来相同，没有观察到向量增益。

cases.context: The two atoms share electrons in a covalent [bond] within the molecule.
cases.review: covalent bond 对应“共价键”；semanticAccepted=false，是短语或其他非向量路径命中，不算通用单词消歧成功。

cases.context: The investor bought a government [bond] that pays annual interest until maturity.
cases.review: government bond 支持“公债”；与旧阶段误选“保释金”不同，最终正确。semanticAccepted=false，不能算向量选义收益。

cases.context: The plant absorbs water through its [root] below the soil surface.
cases.review: plant / absorbs water / below soil 支持植物“根”。

cases.context: Three is the positive square [root] of nine because three multiplied by itself equals nine.
cases.review: square root of nine 对应“平方根”；semanticAccepted=false，归为短语或非向量路径。

cases.context: The biopsy contained damaged muscle [tissue] which the pathologist examined under a microscope.
cases.review: muscle / biopsy / pathologist 支持生物“组织”。默认同时显示“棉纸；组织”和“组织”，正确词出现不代表完成消歧，且重复／无关义项会干扰阅读。

cases.context: She used a disposable paper [tissue] to wipe her nose and then threw it away.
cases.review: disposable paper / wipe her nose 需要“纸巾／面巾纸”。“棉纸；组织”加“组织”既混入生物义，也没有给出这一日常使用的准确首义；纸巾候选已存在。

cases.context: The word [seal] appears on the next page.
cases.review: 只说明单词出现在下一页，缺少语义证据。不标 contextual 且不接受向量提升合理；不能据此断言默认汉译适合某个未知实际义项。

cases.context: They mentioned [spring] again yesterday.
cases.review: mentioned again yesterday 不足以区分季节和弹簧；拒绝提升合理。

cases.context: Please explain [organ] to me.
cases.review: Please explain ... to me 不足以区分器官与风琴；拒绝提升合理。

cases.context: We are discussing [bond] today.
cases.review: discussing ... today 不足以区分化学键、债券等义项；拒绝提升合理。旧式默认动词释义的质量另属词库排序问题，不因为拒判正确就视为可用性已完善。
